typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Account as string,
		{Reporting Date} as string,
		{Net Value} as string,
		{Title (Title)} as string,
		Product as string,
		{Comments Action} as string,
		Client as string,
		Age as string,
		Date as string,
		{Net Position} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource sink(input(
		Account as string,
		Reporting_Date as string,
		Net_Value as double,
		Title__Title_ as string,
		Product as string,
		Comments_Action as string,
		Client as string,
		Age as double,
		Date as string,
		Net_Position as double
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Account,
		Reporting_Date = {Reporting Date},
		Net_Value = {Net Value},
		Title__Title_ = {Title (Title)},
		Product,
		Comments_Action = {Comments Action},
		Client,
		Age,
		Date,
		Net_Position = {Net Position}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
